messages.checking_body: Verifying this account exists. One moment…
messages.not_found_hint: Double-check the name and try again.
messages.twitch_hint: Twitch tracking needs TWITCH_CLIENT_ID and TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET, and this bot has neither configured.
messages.channel_not_found: Couldn't find that channel. Try a #mention or channel name.
messages.limit_guild: This server already follows {max} accounts. Remove one before adding another.
messages.limit_platform: This server already follows {max} {label}s. Remove one before adding another.
messages.added_body:
Now tracking **{name}** on **{platform}**.
New posts will be announced in {channel}.
messages.moved_body: **{name}** was already followed, so it now posts in {channel} instead of its previous channel.
messages.moved_body_short: **{name}** was already followed, now posting in {channel}.
messages.added_footer: -# Pause, ping a role, or write a custom message from the dashboard notifications tab.
messages.need_permission: {cross} You need **Manage Server** permissions to do that.
messages.toggle_gone: {cross} That account is no longer followed.
messages.already_gone_body: **{name}** was not being followed any more.
messages.summary_unhealthy: **Needs a look:** {count} account(s) failed the last check
messages.panel_body:
Get notified when your favourite creators post new content.
Supports: {icons}
messages.panel_footer_dashboard: -# Pause, ping a role, or write a custom message on the dashboard → Notifications
messages.list_empty: Nothing is being tracked yet. Open the setup panel to add accounts!
messages.list_footer: -# Pause or resume an account below, or remove it entirely.
messages.channel_body:
Official staff announcements will now be posted in {channel}.
You can run this command again to move them.
messages.no_follow: {cross} No follow found for **{query}** on **{platform}**. Try `{prefix}notifier list`.
messages.verified_body: **{name}** exists and can be read, but has nothing to announce right now — it may not have uploaded anything yet.
messages.autopause_body:
Niko could not read **{name}** ({platform}) for {limit} checks in a row, so this follow is paused to stop pointless requests.
Use `/notifier resume {platform} {name}` once it is reachable again.
messages.modal_channel_placeholder: Leave blank to use this channel
